Season

Twilight Trails

Tue, Sep 8, 2026, 10:00 AM → Tue, Dec 1, 2026, 10:00 AM (your local time: it happens at local time everywhere)

The current season (Sep 8 – Dec 1), focused on Paldea Pokémon, new Mega Evolutions and Dynamax debuts.

COUNTDOWN & ADD TO CALENDAR

Highlights

  • Paldea arrivals including Maschiff.
  • Mega Staraptor and Mega Chandelure.
  • Dynamax Rhyhorn, Sneasel and Sizzlipede in Max Battles.

Season GO Pass milestones

  • Rank 1: a guaranteed Candy XL from trades (Level 31+).
  • Rank 25: bigger Gift limits.
  • Rank 50: Daily Adventure Incense lasts twice as long.
  • Rank 75: more XP and Stardust from hatching Eggs.

Community Days this season

  • Sep 12 (Classic), Oct 10 and Nov 21.

Tip

Season milestone bonuses stay on until the season ends once you reach them.
